oracle: The replay prints the web::json::value returned by web::json::value::parse(const std::string&) after the documented web::json::keep_object_element_order(true); run-control requires exact JSON tree equality with the control, preserving object member order, array order and integer versus float kinds (number::is_int64 / is_integral), then checks the format-aware summary.
coverage: LLVM source coverage in the cpprest 2.10.19 JSON translation units (Release/src/json/json.cpp, json_parsing.cpp, json_serialization.cpp) reached by web::json::value::parse; json.h inline code, the asyncrt_utils.cpp UTF/locale helpers and the harness are not counted
build_shim: stdafx.h replaces the library's precompiled header (Release/src/pch/stdafx.h), which pulls in HTTP, websocket and Boost.Asio headers; it includes only standard headers and cpprest's own basic_types.h, cpprest_compat.h, version.h, json.h and asyncrt_utils.h. No cpprest source file is modified.
